title: DEATH TERE KI.......(Live comedy show)
description: Maut Kyu Raat Bhar Nahi Aati AKA DEATH TERE Ki is a dark comedy blended with sharp satire, exploring the struggles, frustrations and ironies of an ordinary middle-class man's life. The play revolves around Amit Khanna, an ordinary man crushed under financial difficulties, mounting debts and the burden of family responsibilities. Exhausted by life's endless struggles and unable to find a way out, Amit decides to end his life. What follows is a series of hilarious yet thought-provoking situations as Amit desperately tries to find different ways to die. However, fate seems to have other plans, and every attempt ends in an unexpected comic twist. Through dark humour, situational comedy and biting social satire, the play explores the absurdities of human existence, financial insecurity and the unpredictable nature of life. It leaves the audience laughing at the circumstances while reflecting on a deeper question: Are we really living our lives, or are we simply waiting for life to change
